steps.title: Welcome!
steps.text: Welcome to the Surgewave Bootcamp! This is Unit 0 — your starting point for learning Surgewave.

steps.title: Learning Objectives
steps.text: Each unit starts with clear learning objectives so you know what you'll master.

steps.title: Lessons
steps.text: Units are divided into lessons. Work through them in order for the best learning experience.

steps.title: Navigation
steps.text: Use the sidebar to navigate between units and lessons. Check the Learning Paths page to find the best path for your role.
